{{Top|leg}}
The '''Registry of Testaments and Legacies''' was a registry with the [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaedian]] government that dealt with estates and estate auctions. During [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the head of the Registry sent [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] a message about the purchase of the estate of [[Hidu Rezodar]] and [[Sintas Vel]].
